title: Extract entities
summary: List the people, organisations, dates and places a text mentions.

inputs.text: On 3 March, Maria Lopez of Acme Ltd met Wei Chen in Sydney. Acme Ltd later opened an office in Perth.

sections.use: Pull out the people, organisations, dates and places a text mentions, each exactly as written.
sections.exclusions: No linking, normalising or classifying beyond the four lists; not a de-identification tool.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 4,096 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Input up to 40,000 characters; at most 50 values per list. Each value should be an exact substring of the text; the evaluation checks this.
sections.missing_data: A category with no mentions is an empty list.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.
